questions.title: A quick PI stability check
paragraphs: With unity negative feedback, use G(s)=1/(s+1) and C(s)=1+Ki/s, where Ki>0.
Is the closed loop asymptotically stable for every positive Ki? Justify briefly.

questions.title: Why does the integrator wind up?
paragraphs: An actuator saturates while a PI controller keeps accumulating positive error.
Why can recovery become slow, and how can anti-windup help?

questions.title: A Lyapunov derivative with zeros
paragraphs: For dx/dt=y and dy/dt=-x-y^3, V=(x^2+y^2)/2 gives dV/dt=-y^4.
Do all trajectories approach the origin? Explain why y=0 cannot persist when x is nonzero.

questions.title: Which initial states return to zero?
paragraphs: For dx/dt=-x+x^3, which initial states converge to zero: |x(0)|<1, |x(0)|<=1, or all real values?
Explain your choice.

questions.title: An uncontrollable but stabilizable system
paragraphs: A continuous-time system has A=diag(-1,2), B=[0;1], and feedback u=-Kx.
Can feedback stabilize it even though it is not controllable? Give one suitable K.

questions.title: Can one input control both states?
paragraphs: A continuous-time system has A=[0,1;0,0], B=[0;1].
Is it controllable? Show the matrix [B,AB].

questions.title: How much should a Kalman update move?
paragraphs: For y=x+v, a scalar Kalman filter has prior estimate x_hat=2, prior variance P=1, and independent measurement-noise variance R=3. The new measurement is y=6.
What is the updated estimate?

questions.title: Can state and bias be separated?
paragraphs: A sensor repeatedly reports y=x+b, where both the unknown state x and unknown bias b are constant.
Can an estimator uniquely recover both from these readings alone? Explain.

questions.title: A bounded control move
paragraphs: For x_next=x+u at x=2, minimize (x+u)^2+u^2 subject to -0.5<=u<=0.5.
What input minimizes the cost?

questions.title: What does receding horizon mean?
paragraphs: An MPC solve returns the planned inputs [0.4, 0.1, -0.2].
In standard receding-horizon control, which input is applied now, and what happens at the next sampling instant?

questions.title: Connected, but still no consensus
paragraphs: Two agents synchronously use x1(k+1)=x2(k), x2(k+1)=x1(k). Initially their values are 0 and 2.
Do they converge to consensus? Explain.

questions.title: Consensus can be a weighted average
paragraphs: What common value do they approach? Briefly justify.
